_comment: Configuration for the retrospective agent. An automatic call at an unknown model is an unknown cost, so the model is pinned here rather than left to whatever the interface defaults to.
_note_threshold: Unarchived slice notes required before the gate reports a retro is due. Ten slices is roughly a day of work at a few minutes of execution each.
_model: Passed as --model. Copilot CLI ignores the model field in agent frontmatter, so it must be supplied on the command line.
_allow_hooks: Whether a hook may fire the retro without you asking. Off by default: a script that silently spends quota is a surprise.
_session_state: Override for the session-state directory. Null means autodetect.
